{"user_message": "is this legit?", "emails": [{"from": "it-support@corpmail-support.com", "subject": "Action Required: Mailbox Quota Almost Full", "body": "Hello Team,

Our monitoring shows your mailbox has reached 94% of its allocated storage. To prevent any disruption in sending or receiving messages, please confirm your account details by visiting the secure portal below:

https://mailverify.corpmail-support.com/login

Once verified, your quota will be refreshed and normal service will resume.

Thank you,
IT Helpdesk"}]}

phishing
The sender domain corpmail-support.com is a lookalike for the corporate mail provider and does not match any internal domain. The message manufactures urgency around a quota deadline and drives the reader to a credential form at mailverify.corpmail-support.com, which is the classic quota-expiry credential harvest.
